messages:
deploy-bot: starting v2 rollout rl-2026-06-v2-x at 20% (NA/EU). ramp_policy=staged(20,50,30m,5m). maintenance_window=2026-06-01T22:00Z.

lia: heads-up — this enables header gate X-API-Version: 2. requests with no header will hit a temporary compat shim mapping to v1. shim is intended to be short-lived.

frank: ops/triggers? need clear rollback criteria and pin flow.

ops-oncall: propose rollback if 5xx_rate >= 1.5% for 5m OR p95 latency > 350ms for 10m. Also alert if header_missing_pct > 7% for any tenant for 30m.

lia: added metrics: shim_mapped_to_v1, header_missing_pct, client_version_distribution. docs-bot please add curl examples.

docs-bot: draft created https://confluence.redwood.example/rl-2026-06-v2-x. includes sample curl and SDK snippet.

frank: pin command for ops: `deploybot pin tenant=TENANT_ID version=v1 reason="compat_shim"`. rollback command: `deploybot rollback rl-2026-06-v2-x`. Add maintenance banner step during rollback.

ops-oncall: acknowledged. checklist: (1) check dashboards, (2) run pin when tenant >30% missing header for 15m, (3) flip `compat.allow_missing_version=false` to disable shim, (4) run rollback if triggers hit.

lia: ramped to 35% — snapshot metrics: 5xx_rate=0.0009, p95=210ms, header_missing_pct=5.1%, shim_mapped_to_v1=4.7%.

ops-oncall: metrics look stable. will monitor for next ramp. ping @ops-oncall on alerts. :eyes:
